referral.title: Recommend us to a colleague
referral.text: The service is free for every specialist. Send a colleague the link from our bot: setting up their own bot takes a couple of minutes.

i1.q: How do I create a bot?
i1.a: It takes 2 minutes, and an operator can help at any step. Open @BotFather in Telegram and send /newbot. Pick a name for the bot (e.g. "Ivan — massage") and a username ending in bot (e.g. ivan_massage_bot). Copy the token BotFather sends you, come back to our bot, tap "🤖 Create my bot" and paste the token. If you get stuck, support will help you create the bot: open our bot and tap "💬 Talk to operator".

i2.q: How do I use the service?
i2.a: After registration you get your own bot: share its link with clients. Set up your services, prices and schedule in the mini-app. Clients open the bot and book themselves, choosing a date, duration and time. You get a notification and confirm or decline with a single button. Inside you'll find a calendar, client base, visit history and reminders.

i3.q: How do I replace my bot token?
i3.a: If your token stopped working or you recreated the bot in BotFather, send /replacetoken in our bot and follow the steps.

i4.a: Nothing. The service is free, and every feature is available to every specialist from day one.

i5.a: No. Client self-booking, recurring bookings, session packages (prepaid passes), bulk scheduling tools, and revenue and workload analytics are available to everyone, with no limits on the number of clients or bookings.

i6.q: How do I invite a colleague?
i6.a: Open our bot and tap "🤝 Invite a colleague": your personal link is there. Send it to a fellow specialist.

i7.q: How do I add or edit a service?
i7.a: Go to Settings > Services & Prices. Add a service or open an existing one, then set its name, price, duration, and photo.

i8.q: How do I set working hours and breaks?
i8.a: Go to Settings > Schedule. Add one or more working intervals for a day. Any gap between intervals appears as a break in the admin calendar.

i9.q: How do I block days off?
i9.a: Go to Settings > Days Off, select a date, add an optional reason, and save it. Clients will not be able to book blocked days.

i10.q: How do I add a client via Telegram?
i10.a: Share your Telegram bot link with the client. Once they tap Start in the bot and open the booking app, they will automatically appear in your client list. You can find the link to your bot in your Telegram profile.

i11.q: How do I add a client who does not use Telegram?
i11.a: Go to Settings > Clients, tap +, and add a guest client. You can then book sessions for them yourself from the admin booking flow.

i12.q: How do I find a client?
i12.a: Use the search bar in Settings > Clients. Search works by client name, display name, and phone.

i13.q: How do I message a client?
i13.a: Open a booking or a new request and tap Message. Messaging is available only for clients with a Telegram account linked to the booking.

i14.q: How do I handle new booking requests?
i14.a: On the admin home screen, open New Requests. You can accept, reject, or message the client if they can be reached in Telegram.

i15.q: Where can I see all bookings?
i15.a: Go to All Bookings from the admin dashboard. Use filters for status, date, client, service, and sorting.

i16.q: How do I reschedule or cancel a booking?
i16.a: Open the booking from the calendar or All Bookings. Choose Reschedule to pick a new date and time, or Cancel to cancel with an optional reason.

i17.q: What happens if a client cancels too late?
i17.a: If the cancellation policy is enabled, the booking is counted as completed rather than cancelled. The client sees a warning before confirming but can still proceed. You can set the cutoff window in Settings > Schedule > Cancellation policy.

i18.q: How do I set up the cancellation policy?
i18.a: Go to Settings > Schedule and scroll down to the Cancellation policy section. Enable the toggle and set how many hours in advance clients must notify you of a cancellation or reschedule. If a client cancels after that deadline, the session is automatically marked as completed instead of cancelled.

i19.a: No. You can add a client without Telegram manually: enter their name in the clients section and put them on the schedule yourself, and the booking is confirmed right away. Clients on Telegram book on their own through your bot. Both kinds show up in the same calendar and client base. Reminders and notifications only reach clients who use Telegram.

i20.q: I rent a room with a colleague — will this work?
i20.a: Yes. Turn on "By dates" mode: clients only see the days you open in the calendar. The room has a shared calendar where every day belongs to one specialist and colors show who works when, so there are no double bookings. Your colleague can use their own bot or have none: then you mark their days.
